summary: TCM Group A/S manufactures and sells kitchen and furniture products for bathrooms and storage in Denmark, Norway, and internationally. The company offers kitchen, bathroom and utility room fixtures, and sliding door cabinets under the Svane Køkkenet, Tvis køkken, Nettoline, AUBO, and private label brands. It also manufactures do-it-yourself solutions for private label and independent kitchen stores. In addition, the company supplies e-commerce kitchen business Celebert, which operates under the brands kitchn.dk, billigskabe. dk, Celebert, and Just Wood. TCM Group A/S was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Holstebro, Denmark.
